name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, with a kettlebell on the floor a short distance in front of you.
Hinge at your hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees, grip the handle with both hands, and hike the kettlebell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward explosively, squeezing your glutes to swing the kettlebell up to about chest height. Your arms should stay relaxed and act only as a connection to the weight.
Let the kettlebell swing back down, hinging at the hips as it passes between your legs while keeping your back flat.
Immediately drive your hips forward into the next repetition, and continue for the desired number of reps.
